title: MemeLens: Multilingual Multitask VLMs for Memes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Model (VLM) classification performance (Accuracy, Macro-F1) on multimodal meme datasets annotated for misogyny, objectification, shaming, and gender stereotyping (e.g., MAMI and MIMIC datasets).
Evaluating VLM classification performance on specialized datasets (e.g., MIMIC Islamophobic Memes) annotated for anti-Muslim and Islamophobic multimodal content.

Benchmarking models on several large-scale hateful meme datasets (e.g., Facebook Hateful Memes, MMHS, Multi3Hate) that require identifying hate speech targeting various protected characteristics such as race, religion, and gender.
